preconditions.description: The number of rows in the museum is at least 3 and at most 1000.
The number of columns in the museum is at least 3 and at most 1000.
The number of starting positions is at least 1 and at most the total number of cells in the museum.
The museum is represented by '.' for empty cells and '*' for impassable cells.
The museum has impassable borders that prevent Igor from leaving the museum.

preconditions.expression: All starting positions are empty cells
preconditions.description: Igor can start in any of the empty cells within the museum.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == maximum number of pictures Igor can see starting from position i
postconditions.description: The output for each starting position should be the maximum number of pictures Igor can see from that position.
